title: Seven Days
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Touji Seryou, one of the most popular boys at school, is rumored to date whoever asks him out first on a Monday and break up with them by the end of the week. One Monday, on a whim, archery club senior Yuzuru Shino asks him out as a joke, and Seryou accepts; over the seven days, the question becomes whether Shino will be the exception.
life_message: Real love asks for honesty and commitment, not a relationship kept at arm's length.
